text_zh: 火中涅槃之鸟，其羽化作不熄之烛。站点污染时，汝之铭刻将重燃如初。
text_en: Born of flame eternal, its feathers burn as undying candles. When sites falter, your inscription shall rekindle anew.

text_zh:
分级: Apollyon
发现地点: 第V层执事试炼室，M.1██
征用编号: R-███

描述: 镀金鸟形圣器，内嵌退火铅字一枚。收容震颤时自发复燃，重置流沙流至预设基准。执事试炼与意志显现期间会额外激活残余异文。

备注: 原供奉于崇拜时代祭坛。██████ ████后被移至收容层。D级人员征用后失联率下降73%，但第V层以上异文活跃度显著增加。

最后更新: M.2██ - Scriptor ████
text_en:
Classification: Apollyon
Recovery Site: Layer V Deacon Trial Chamber, M.1██

Description: Gilt avian artifact containing single annealed lead glyph. Auto-ignites during containment tremors, resetting hourglass humour to baseline parameters. Exhibits enhanced residual anomaly generation during Deacon Trials and Will Manifestations.

Notes: Originally housed in Worship Era altar assemblage. Relocated to containment layers following ██████ ████ incident. D-class requisition reduces casualty rates by 73%, though anomalous activity above Layer V increases substantially.
